structure.unit: Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Municipal Public Property; Public Utilities

law.catch_line: Prescriptive easements for provision of water and sewer services
law.text: In an action to establish a prescriptive easement involving the provision of water and sewer services, a political subdivision shall demonstrate that the use has continued for a period of at least ten years. This section shall not affect any other requirement which may be necessary to establish a prescriptive easement.
